name: Restaurant OMV Tankstelle
kurzbeschreibung:
**Fuel up with flavor at Restaurant OMV Tankstelle in Ried im Oberinntal!**

Tucked away at the **OMV Tankstelle** in the charming village of **Ried im Oberinntal**, this cozy spot serves up hearty Austrian classics with a smile. Start your day with a fresh **Kaiserschmarrn** drizzled with apricot jam or dig into a sizzling **Schweinsbraten** with crispy knödel and tangy mustard. Wash it down with a crisp **Tiroler Bier** or a smooth **Grüner Veltliner**—all while enjoying the scenic views of the **Inntal**.

Perfect for a quick bite before hitting the road or a relaxed stopover on your **Tirol** adventure, this roadside gem delivers authentic taste without the fuss. **Willkommen bei OMV!**
